content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the marijampolė district court the court decided to dissolve a marriage and awarded a car to both parties involved the court also declared that a third party is jointly responsible for a loan agreement the applicant requested maintenance for their children and the division of movable property the defendant disputed access to the children and requested a visitation schedule the court examined the case in the absence of the defendant and ordered the payment of maintenance by the defendant the defendant is required to pay the costs of the proceedings the court found the defendant at fault for the issues between the spouses and ordered them to keep the car the court also ordered the defendant to pay additional costs for legal assistance the rest of the action was dismissed
